declarations.description:
One row of actions or links that never wraps: the children that do not fit fold into a "More" menu at the end (or
at the start, with `collapse-from="start"`). The row refits whenever the list is resized, a child's size changes,
or children are added and removed, in a single pass over sizes it already knows: folded children stay laid out,
invisible and inert, so they keep reporting their size and come back as soon as there is room.

The menu is built from the folded children, in document order: each becomes a `c2-menu-item` named after the
child (`data-overflow-label`, then `aria-label`, `label`, `tooltip`, `title`, then its text) with a copy of its
icon (`prefix-icon`, or the content of a `c2-icon-button`). A disabled child is a disabled row, a toggle
(`toggle` or `aria-pressed`) is a checkbox row checked while the child is `selected` or pressed, and activating a row clicks the child itself, so its listeners,
form submission and link navigation work unchanged. `hr`, `c2-separator` and `role="separator"` children divide
groups in the row and in the menu, and are dropped at either edge. Rows slotted into `menu` are always listed
after the folded ones, which keeps the trigger visible.

Children are read, never written. `data-overflow="pinned"` keeps a child in the row whatever the room;
`data-overflow-priority="<n>"` makes it stay longer than lower-priority children (default 0), ties folding from the
collapse edge. `min-visible` keeps that many children even when they overflow, `max-visible` caps them.

When the child holding focus folds, focus moves to the trigger, so it is never lost. The trigger is named after
the count ("3 more items"), and says "including current item" when a folded child is the current page
(`aria-current`) or a selected link (`selected`); the list matches `:state(overflowing)` while something is
folded and `:state(current-hidden)` in that second case.

Give the list a width: it is a block, so it fills its container (in a flex row set `flex: 1` and `min-width: 0`).
The gap between children is part of the fit; margins on the children are not.
declarations.name: OverflowList

cssProperties.description: Space between the children and before the trigger, included in the fit.
cssProperties.name: --c2-overflow-list--gap

cssProperties.description: Space between the parts of slotted `more` content.
cssProperties.name: --c2-overflow-list__more--gap

cssProperties.description: Also the background while the menu is open.
cssProperties.name: --c2-overflow-list__more__hover--background-color

cssProperties.description: Trigger text while a folded child is the current item.
cssProperties.name: --c2-overflow-list__more__current--color

cssProperties.description: Weight of the menu row of the current item.
cssProperties.name: --c2-overflow-list__current-item--font-weight

cssProperties.description: Colour of an `hr` child between groups in the row.
cssProperties.name: --c2-overflow-list__separator--color

cssParts.description: The flex row holding the visible children and the trigger.
cssParts.name: row

cssParts.description: The trigger, a native button that opens the menu.
cssParts.name: more

slots.description: The children: `c2-button`, `c2-icon-button`, `c2-link-button`, links, any element, and `hr` / `c2-separator` between groups.
`c2-menu-item` rows always listed in the menu, after the folded children. Their `menu-select` events bubble as usual.
slots.name: menu

slots.description: Content of the trigger, replacing the ⋯ icon (for example the text "More" and a chevron). The trigger keeps its counted name.
slots.name: more

members.name: collapseFrom
members.description: The edge whose children fold first; the trigger sits on that edge.

members.name: minVisible
members.description: Children kept in the row even when they do not fit.

members.name: maxVisible
members.description: Most children to show, whatever the room. Unset shows as many as fit.

members.name: placement
members.description: Placement of the menu. Defaults to `bottom-end`, or `bottom-start` when collapsing from the start.

members.name: entries
members.description: The children laid out in the row or folded: everything but the `menu` and `more` content, in document order.

members.name: measured
members.description: Whether the row has been fitted once. Until then the trigger stays idle, as the server rendered it.

members.name: iconCopies
members.default: new WeakMap<Element, { from: Element; copy: Element }>()

members.name: hiddenItems
members.description: The children currently folded into the menu, in document order (separators not included).

members.name: observeShadow
members.description: Watches the room the row has and the trigger's own width (a new trigger when it moves to the other edge).

members.name: handleMutations
members.description:
Re-reads the children when one is added, removed or re-slotted, or changes how it folds; redraws the trigger
and the menu rows when a child changes what they show. Changes deeper inside a child are left alone.

members.name: shownEntries
members.description: The entries shown in the row when `folded` are in the menu: separators only between two shown children.

members.name: fit
members.description: Decides which children fold: none when everything fits, otherwise the fewest, in folding order.

members.name: assignNamedSlots
members.description:
A declarative shadow root (server rendering) is always in named mode, where `assign()` has no effect: route the
folded children by `slot` attribute instead, touching only the attribute this list wrote.

members.name: renderRows
members.description: The folded children as menu rows, with a separator wherever the row had one between two of them.

events.name: overflow-change
events.description: The number of folded children changed. `detail` has `visibleCount` and `hiddenCount`. Does not bubble.

attributes.name: collapse-from
attributes.description: The edge whose children fold first; the trigger sits on that edge.
